    await asyncio.sleep(0.4)

    # Try to dismiss any obvious popup/modal with Escape first
    await page.keyboard.press("Escape")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.25)

    # If a dialog is exposed in the accessibility tree, attempt to close it via an accessible button inside it
    dialog = page.get_by_role("dialog")
    if await dialog.count() > 0:
        # Try common accessible names for a close control inside the dialog
        close_names = ["Close", "Dismiss", "×", "Close this popup", "Close dialog"]
        closed = False
        for name in close_names:
            btn = dialog.get_by_role("button", name=name)
            if await btn.count() > 0:
                await btn.click()
                closed = True
                await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
                break
        if not closed:
            # Fallback: click the first button inside the dialog (still scoped through the dialog)
            buttons = dialog.get_by_role("button")
            if await buttons.count() > 0:
                await buttons.nth(0).click()
                await asyncio.sleep(0.25)

    # Helper: safely attempt to find the November 2025 link inside a container locator
    async def try_container_click(container):
        if await container.count() == 0:
            return False
        cnt = await container.count()
        for i in range(cnt):
            c = container.nth(i)
            link = c.get_by_role("link", name="November 2025")
            if await link.count() > 0:
                await link.click()
                return True
        return False

    # 1) Try complementary[name="Archives"]
    comp = page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Archives")
    if await try_container_click(comp):
        return

    # 2) Try region[name="Archives"]
    region = page.get_by_role("region", name="Archives")
    if await try_container_click(region):
        return

    # 3) Iterate through all complementary/region containers in case Archives is unnamed
    for role in ["complementary", "region"]:
        containers = page.get_by_role(role)
        if await try_container_click(containers):
            return

    # 4) Fallback: click any visible link named "November 2025" anywhere on the page
    direct = page.get_by_role("link", name="November 2025")
    if await direct.count() > 0:
        await direct.click()
        return

    # 5) As a last attempt, go to the site root and repeat the checks (relative goto)
    await page.goto('/')
    await asyncio.sleep(0.4)

    comp = page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Archives")
    if await try_container_click(comp):
        return
    region = page.get_by_role("region", name="Archives")
    if await try_container_click(region):
        return
    for role in ["complementary", "region"]:
        containers = page.get_by_role(role)
        if await try_container_click(containers):
            return
    direct = page.get_by_role("link", name="November 2025")
    if await direct.count() > 0:

        return
